Claim 8 (Currently amended): A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from 1 to 99% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 1 to 99% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition __exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at 200°C for 14 days, and wherein the lubricant is present in an amount of 1 to 500 parts by weight per 100 parts by weight of refrigerant__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone __and a carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a polyol selected from the group consisting of neopentyl glycol, trimethylolpropane, pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol __and a carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 2 to 15 carbon atoms __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of neopentyl glycol, trimethylolpropane, pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the composition comprises from 10 to 50% by weight of the at least one polyol ester.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises at least one PVE, wherein the at least one PVE is a copolymer of ethyl vinyl ether and t-butyl vinyl ether units __in a weight ratio of approximately 9:1__.

Claim 16 (Cancelled): [[The composition according to Claim 16, wherein the copolymer comprises from 50 to 95% by weight of Unit 1.]]

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 5 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 95% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 35% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 65 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone __and a carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid __and a polyol selected from the group consisting of pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol__.

Claim 25 (Cancelled): [[The composition according to claim 1, wherein the refrigerant further comprises 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane.]]

Claim 26 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a pentaerythritol ester.

Claim 27 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a pentaerythritol ester.

Claim 28 (Previously presented): The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a pentaerythritol ester.
